notes.title: RPG MAKER FESTIVAL 2025 SALE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040273/26e34d0e839daea332f366d80f10846ffd50da31.png[/img]

Alister in Wonderland is a dark fantasy RPG that reimagines the classic Alice in Wonderland tale with a twisted, psychological twist. Play as Alister, a boy who finds himself trapped in a dreamlike world filled with eerie landscapes, unsettling creatures, and riddles that challenge both his mind and morality. With choices that shape the story, hauntingly beautiful pixel art, and an emotionally gripping narrative, Alister in Wonderland takes players on a surreal journey where reality bends and nothing is as it seems.

🎮 Why Play?
✨ Story-driven adventure – Unravel Alister’s fate through branching paths and multiple endings.
🕵️ Puzzle-solving gameplay – Navigate Wonderland’s mysteries, solve riddles, and uncover secrets.
🎨 Atmospheric pixel art – Immerse yourself in a beautifully eerie world inspired by classic fairy tales.
🎵 Haunting soundtrack – A chilling and emotional OST that enhances the experience.

Now is the perfect time to dive into Alister in Wonderland with 60% off during the RPG Maker Festival 2025! Don't miss your chance to experience this surreal dark fantasy RPG.

Thank you for the continued support!
